title: Support for mixed posting group classes in secondary schools
asked: Whether schools have the resources and training to handle any negative effects of posting group banding and to encourage inclusivity, interaction and friendships among students from different posting groups in the same class.
response: Ms Jasmin Lau said posting groups guide entry into secondary schools and subject levels at Secondary 1. Under Full Subject-Based Banding, students are placed in mixed form classes and spend about a third of curriculum time on common subjects like Art and Character Citizenship Education. Schools also use CCAs and Values-in-Action projects for interaction, and MOE gives teachers resources and professional development, including termly check-in surveys on students' interests, emotional well-being and peer support networks. In reply to supplementary questions, she said support focuses on emotional well-being and tools to map peer support networks, and MOE will share teachers' approaches to mixed form classes.
